verdict.rationale: Microsoft's privacy FAQ explicitly documents a setting to 'opt out of use of your conversation activity for model training' alongside disclosure that conversations 'train our generative AI models' by default, showing the capability exists. However, community evidence shows real user confusion about whether integrated Office Copilot (e.g., Word) usage is being sent for training, indicating the control's visibility/scope is unclear in practice. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the opt-out mechanism's scope (all products vs. just Copilot chat), independent verification that opting out actually excludes data from training, and clarity for enterprise/Office-integrated Copilot uses.
